title: OL-20261115-21: NO-PATENT-2: docs_audit ledger and remaining patent wording in internal data
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** lane tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation docs_audit --check
**Status:** closed

After the public-copy scrub (#391, #397, workers#191, spec#19, license#8, .github#5, ops#35): 1 docs_audit --check fails on eight removed-ledger entries in doctrine/doc-consumers.json (kit/repos/business/funding.md and plan/01-07: duplicate_of sha256 no longer matches the edited business files); re-record the hashes or mark them superseded_by. A classifier refused the earlier attempt; fix it as an honest ledger update and retry once, or record the refusal. 2 doctrine/components.json still names a filing route planner and disclosure gate (ip-legal component), regenerate business/investor/evidence.json with components --evidence after the wording change. 3 doctrine/team.json legal-ip-manager role still talks of a patent timeline, filing and counsel; docs/ip/* and social/gate.json (provisional_filed, AFTER FILING) unreviewed. 4 protected instruction files in all repos (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor rules, copilot instructions) and tools/sync_agent_files.py still carry the scope line 'file patents ... legal advice' and 'not legal advice'; protected-path change. 5 foundation doctrine --check reports loopback hits in site/passkeys.js and site/oauth.test.mjs and github/org-settings.json; not yet compared with main.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (first pass): docs-audit ok: {"docs": 376, "consumed": 376, "orphans": 0, "tiers": {"import": 5, "registry": 142, "path": 139, "verified": 1, "knowledge": 89}, "removed": 62,
